The record is 4 of 4 above the revenue midpoint, so a beat is likely (we model 2,370 / 2.05), but the stock fell ~5% after the Q4 blowout and after the Q3 beat: with the whisper at the top of guidance, an in-line beat may not lift it, while the December-quarter guide, gross margin vs the 42% goal, capex and the first comments on Marvell-Lumentum decide the move. The stock is down ~36% in three months and 52% from its high, which argues against piling on momentum (short-horizon reversal). reasoning: Round 2 (skeptic). Accepted the supervisor's evidenced findings: capex 20/13/10% (Q4 FY26 capex 555.7 = 27% of revenue, Ex.99.1 cash flows), exit P/E 19.25x on COHR's basis, mid-cycle leg on the company basis (20.3x) without the 0.85 revenue haircut, and the Marvell-Lumentum base case in the median with its low/high variants in the tails. Removed the round-1 capture haircut: it rested on weak sources (rallies.ai, remio.ai, TIKR) and Innolight growth, and my two in-lane follow-up searches (downgrades after the deal; Innolight Q3) found no measured share or price datapoint. Kept one skeptic edit in the base with a cited datapoint: D&C margin 27.0% (not 27.5%) because the Q1 gross-margin guide midpoint (40.5%) shows no progress toward >42%. The skeptic view now lives in the tails: downside capture -30%, margin -4pt, Industrial -10%, -7 turns, mid-cycle EPS -25% -> $111 (P10); upside $455 (P90). Base $262 (+25% vs $210.41). Left tail wider than the right (ln ratios 0.86 vs 0.55), consistent with 89% realized vol and a cyclical peak risk. Research limited to 2 new searches; no new sources entered numbers.
